## New
- **Playlist details like you know them:** new playlists and "Edit details" open one dialog with picture, name and description. Upload a picture and choose position and zoom, or make a cover from a colour and a symbol
- **Share playlists two ways:** "Link to listen" opens in any browser without signing in. "Invite collaborators" lets other people on your server add songs to the playlist. You see who takes part and can remove people, and they can leave again
- **ZimaOS and CasaOS:** one command installs Musik as an app on the dashboard, see the website

## Better
- **Tab bar:** the marker of the selected tab now keeps the same distance to the bar on every side

## Install
- **Update server:** Settings → Updates → Update now (or run the Proxmox script / `musik-update`)
- **ZimaOS:** `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Labtoso/Musik/main/deploy/zimaos.sh | bash`
- **Android:** uninstall Musik once, then install the new `Musik.apk`
- **Windows:** Settings → Updates, or run the new `Musik.exe`
- **Linux:** Settings → Updates, or `chmod +x Musik.AppImage && ./Musik.AppImage`
